title: David Ellison says HBO will air critical Elon Musk documentary despite his $1B investment in Skydance | TechCrunch
summary: Skydance CEO David Ellison says HBO will air Alex Gibney’s documentary about Elon Musk, even after news broke that the SpaceX founder had invested $1 billion in the newly formed company following its Warner Bro.
